# Engineering Interests

Minimizing complexity in distributed systems. Preference for
decentralized architectures and small, reliable components. Linux-native.
Critical of heavy abstractions (e.g. Kubernetes) outside the narrow
contexts where they earn their cost. Reliability over feature breadth.

# Selected Project

**Buffy** · A Protocol Buffers build and publishing tool

_Open-Source (2026 - present)_

Single-binary CLI that compiles `.proto` files into client stubs for
Go, Java, and Rust, and publishes them to GitHub, Maven Central, and
crates.io from one `Buffy.toml`. Replaces hand-rolled `protoc`
invocations and per-language release scripts with a single declarative
config. (Visit documentation at [books.julian-siebert.de/buffy](https://books.julian-siebert.de/buffy))
